objective.mul.meaning: Understand multiplication as equal groups, repeated addition and arrays
objective.div.meaning: Understand division as sharing and as grouping
objective.div.tables: Divide within the small times tables
objective.big.tens: Multiply tens by a one-digit number: 30 · 3
objective.big.mul-2d1d: Multiply a two-digit number by a one-digit number
objective.big.div-2d1d: Divide a two-digit number by a one-digit number
objective.order.precedence: Multiply and divide before adding and subtracting
objective.compare.expressions: Compare products and expressions with <, > and =
objective.word.equal-groups: Word problems with equal groups and fair sharing
objective.word.times-more-fewer: Word problems: N times as many, N times fewer
objective.word.more-fewer-contrast: Tell "N more" apart from "N times as many"
objective.terms.div: Terms: dividend, divisor, quotient and remainder
word.equal-groups.nests: {name} finds {nests} nests. Each nest has {eggs} eggs. How many eggs are there?
word.sharing.berries: {name} has {total} berries and {baskets} baskets. Each basket gets the same number. How many berries go in each basket?
word.more-than.flowers: {name} picks {picked} flowers. {friend} picks {more} more. How many flowers does {friend} pick?
story.prologue.1: Long ago, the Seven-Headed Dragon caught a cold.
story.prologue.2: Achoo! The Magic Window shattered into sparkly panes.
story.prologue.3: All the dragon eggs in the valley went cold.
story.prologue.4: Old Glimmer needs a new Dragon Keeper. That is you!
story.first-egg.choose: Choose your first egg. Which one feels warm?
story.first-egg.chosen: Great choice! Let's warm it up with some practice.
story.meadow-welcome.1: Welcome to Sunny Meadow! The flowers love counting.
story.meadow-welcome.2: Dragons hatch when you practise. Let's begin!
story.bridge-troll.1: A big troll sits on the old bridge.
story.bridge-troll.2: He grumbles and will not let anyone cross.
story.bridge-troll.3: Glimmer whispers: make him laugh with your answers!
story.troll-laughs.1: The troll laughs so hard that he rolls over!
story.troll-laughs.2: The bridge is open. New adventures are waiting!
